patch:
diff --git a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-muse-rerun-cycle4-checkpoint.md b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-muse-rerun-cycle4-checkpoint.md
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..104cc8b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-muse-rerun-cycle4-checkpoint.md
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+# SM89 Muse rerun cycle 4 checkpoint
+
+Cycle 4 is paused after one rejected candidate. The current accepted source remains `1d0bac78`
+(exact-BN40 CC89 Muse W8 head), documented at `ba77659d`. The isolated branch is restored by
+`de0b5fab`; no cycle-4 candidate source is retained.
+
+Fresh accepted-source baseline at Muse DFlash2 draft4, INT8-G64, 8K/request, C8:
+52.2100 ms / 647.100 tok/s and 52.2431 ms / 646.505 tok/s, both with 992 drafted / 800 accepted.
+The 0.0331 ms repeat spread is the cycle noise reference. C1-C7 GPU means were 36.3605, 39.7741,
+45.5351, 40.8828, 73.6690, 74.8721, and 65.1324 ms. The measured profile attributed 43.5% to
+Q4 R32, 35.6% to Q4 R64, 6.8% to D128 GQA partial/reduce, and 5.8% to exact-BN40 W8.
+
+Candidate `1021b5f9` changed only the exact-BN40 W8 activation pipeline from one to two stages. It
+passed the W8 oracle and compiled at 96 registers/thread, 46,080 bytes shared/block, and zero local
+memory. Cold T40 improved from 1,870.848 to 1,748.992 us (-6.51%), with dispatch seams unchanged.
+Its first matched real pair improved 52.2836 ms / 645.559 tok/s to 52.0835 ms / 648.075 tok/s,
+identical 992/800 accounting. The +2.516 tok/s and 0.38% latency gains missed both acceptance arms,
+so a second pair was unnecessary. It was rejected and normally reverted by `de0b5fab`.
+
+If resumed, candidate numbering continues at c4_02 from the preserved `1d0bac78` binary and the
+fresh baseline above. No c4_02 source mutation was started.
